strategy_roster.name: RSI Dynamic Overbought Oversold
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(rsi(close,14), sma(rsi(close,14),50) + 2.0 * std(rsi(close,14),50)) and close > sma(close,50)
strategy_roster.notes: The docs state no explicit condition, so the documented parts are combined: the dynamic overbought level is the MovingAvgPeriod=50 mean of RSI(14) plus StdDevMultiplier=2.0 standard deviations, crossed upward with price above the 50 MA, and the RSI mean or the MA loss is the opposite-signal exit. StopLossPercent=2.0m becomes the 2.0 percent stop; the ATR-multiple stop and 5-minute series are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Volatility Adjusted Moving Average
strategy_roster.notes: The documented upper band is MAPeriod=20 plus ATRMultiplier=2.0 times ATR(14) and a cross back through the baseline closes the long, so the volatility-adaptive stop is left to the band itself. No numeric percent stop is supplied, so both percent fields are null and the 5-minute series is unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Bulls & Bears Power Average
strategy_roster.entry_long: roc((high + low) / 2 - ema(close,5),1) > 0 and (high + low) / 2 - ema(close,5) < 0
strategy_roster.notes: Bulls Power (high-EMA) and Bears Power (low-EMA) average to (high+low)/2 minus MaPeriod=5 EMA, and the documented long requires that average rising while still below zero; the falling average is the opposite signal and closes. The optional 15/95 pip stop and target are absolute price distances, not percentages.

strategy_roster.name: 4 SMA
strategy_roster.entry_long: sma((high + low) / 2,5) > sma((high + low) / 2,20) and sma((high + low) / 2,20) > sma((high + low) / 2,40) and sma((high + low) / 2,40) > sma((high + low) / 2,60) and roc(sma((high + low) / 2,5),1) > 0
strategy_roster.exit_long: sma((high + low) / 2,5) < sma((high + low) / 2,20) or sma((high + low) / 2,20) < sma((high + low) / 2,60)
strategy_roster.notes: All four documented lengths (5, 20, 40, 60) are kept on median prices, with a long requiring full bullish alignment plus a rising fast average, and the exit when the fast/medium or medium/very-slow ordering inverts. The 50-point take-profit, 50-point stop, and 11-point trailing are point distances, not percent fields.

strategy_roster.name: US30 Stealth
strategy_roster.entry_long: roc(sma(close,50),3) > 0.1 and low > donchian_low_prev(low,5) and close > open and close > donchian_high_prev(high,1) and volume_ratio(volume,20) > 1
strategy_roster.notes: MaLen=50 slope over MaSlopeLen=3 above MinSlope=0.1, a higher low over HlLookback=5, a bullish engulfing-style bar closing above the prior high, and volume above VolMaLen=20 average are all kept. The session time filter, MaxCandleSize and LargeCandleThreshold checks, the RrRatio=2.2 candle-range protections, and the risk-based sizing are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Return Asymmetry Commodity
strategy_roster.notes: The signal is a cross-sectional monthly ranking across several commodity futures, which a single-security DSL cannot compute, so the asymmetry measure collapses to the security's own positive drift over WindowDays=120 confirmed by the 60-bar half-window. TopN allocation, MinTradeUsd capping, the short leg, and the monthly rebalance are dropped; the docs specify no stop.

strategy_roster.name: RRS Randomness
strategy_roster.notes: Entries are generated by a random generator that alternates or gates direction, so there is no market-derived condition and the never-true negative-price guard prevents fabricating one. Random volumes, point stop/target, trailing offsets, spread filter, and floating-loss liquidation are not DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: WPR Custom Cloud Simple
strategy_roster.entry_long: donchian_high(high,14) - donchian_low(low,14) > 0 and crossabove(-100 * (donchian_high(high,14) - close) / (donchian_high(high,14) - donchian_low(low,14)), -80)
strategy_roster.exit_long: donchian_high(high,14) - donchian_low(low,14) > 0 and crossbelow(-100 * (donchian_high(high,14) - close) / (donchian_high(high,14) - donchian_low(low,14)), -20)
strategy_roster.notes: Williams %R(14) is rebuilt from the documented lookback with a non-zero range guard, crossing up through OversoldLevel=-80 opens the long and crossing down through OverboughtLevel=-20 reverses it, exactly as the reference does. The EA deliberately places no stop-loss or take-profit, so both percent fields are null.

strategy_roster.name: TCPivotLimit
strategy_roster.notes: Target Variant 1 is assumed (entry at S1 with the R1 target), implemented from the documented previous-day pivot with the current close standing in for the previous close, so S1 = 2P-H and R1 = 2P-L. The S2/R2 protective levels, the other four variants, the 23:00 session close, and the stop modification after the first target are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Times Direction
strategy_roster.notes: The strategy opens and closes purely on candle-clock windows with no indicators at all (default Trade = Sell), so it has no market-derived entry signal and the never-true guard is used. The 1000/2000 price-unit stop and target and the configurable direction cannot be expressed in the DSL.
